IN THE UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
FOR THE NORTHERN DISTRICT OF ILLINOIS

PLAINTIFF ACME INDUSTRIES, INC.,
vs.
DEFENDANT GLOBAL HOLDINGS, LLC.

MOTION TO COMPEL DISCOVERY AND MOTION FOR DISCOVERY SANCTIONS

Plaintiff, through undersigned attorney, hereby files this motion to compel discovery and motion for discovery sanctions, and in support thereof states as follows:

Plaintiff filed a complaint alleging breach of contract, breach of fiduciary duty, and negligence against defendant. Defendant filed an answer and counterclaim. Plaintiff served interrogatories, requests for production, and requests for admission. Defendant failed to respond to discovery within the time prescribed by the scheduling order and case management order.

Plaintiff filed a notice of motion and notice of hearing. Plaintiff attended the status conference and pretrial conference, at which time administrative law judge ordered defendant to comply with discovery obligations. Despite the protective order governing confidential information, defendant has produced no document production and has provided no privilege log.

Plaintiff seeks motion for sanctions and motion for disclosure sanctions. Plaintiff further moves for motion to compel response to discovery and motion to compel production of documents. The burden of proof rests with defendant to demonstrate that attorney-client privilege and attorney work product protection apply to each withheld document.

Plaintiff has met the requirements for standing and personal jurisdiction. The statute of limitations has not expired. Plaintiff relies on precedent establishing that spoliation of evidence warrants an adverse inference, citing res judicata and collateral estoppel.

Plaintiff further requests that this filing be considered as a motion in limine to exclude evidence that defendant may seek to introduce at trial or bench trial, including motion in limine to exclude testimony and motion in limine to exclude expert testimony from any fact witness or expert report that defendant has failed to disclose.

WHEREFORE, Plaintiff respectfully requests that this Court enter an order granting the motion to compel discovery, imposing sanctions, and awarding attorney fees.

Respectfully submitted,
[Attorney Name]
[Law Firm]

IN THE UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
FOR THE NORTHERN DISTRICT OF ILLINOIS

PLAINTIFF ACME INDUSTRIES, INC.,
vs.
DEFENDANT GLOBAL HOLDINGS, LLC.

MOTION TO COMPEL DISCOVERY AND MOTION FOR DISCOVERY SANCTIONS

Plaintiff, through undersigned attorney, hereby files this motion to compel discovery and motion for discovery sanctions, and in support thereof states as follows:
Plaintiff filed a complaint alleging breach of contract, breach of fiduciary duty, and negligence against defendant.
Defendant filed an answer and counterclaim.
Plaintiff served interrogatories, requests for production, and requests for admission.
Defendant failed to respond to discovery within the time prescribed by the scheduling order and case management order.
Plaintiff filed a notice of motion and notice of hearing.
Plaintiff attended the status conference and pretrial conference, at which time administrative law judge ordered defendant to comply with discovery obligations.
Despite the protective order governing confidential information, defendant has produced no document production and has provided no privilege log.
Plaintiff seeks motion for sanctions and motion for disclosure sanctions.
Plaintiff further moves for motion to compel response to discovery and motion to compel production of documents.
The burden of proof rests with defendant to demonstrate that attorney-client privilege and attorney work product protection apply to each withheld document.
Plaintiff has met the requirements for standing and personal jurisdiction.
The statute of limitations has not expired.
Plaintiff relies on precedent establishing that spoliation of evidence warrants an adverse inference, citing res judicata and collateral estoppel.

Plaintiff further requests that this filing be considered as a motion in limine to exclude evidence that defendant may seek to introduce at trial or bench trial, including motion in limine to exclude testimony and motion in limine to exclude expert testimony from any fact witness or expert report that defendant has failed to disclose.
WHEREFORE, Plaintiff respectfully requests that this Court enter an order granting the motion to compel discovery, imposing sanctions, and awarding attorney fees.

Respectfully submitted,
[Attorney Name]

[Law Firm]

Plaintiff, through undersigned attorney, hereby files this motion to compel discovery and motion for discovery sanctions, and in support thereof states as follows:

Plaintiff filed a complaint alleging breach of contract, breach of fiduciary duty, and negligence against defendant. Defendant filed an answer and counterclaim. Plaintiff further requests that this filing be considered as a motion in limine to exclude evidence that defendant may seek to introduce at trial or bench trial, including motion in limine to exclude testimony and motion in limine to exclude expert testimony from any fact witness or expert report that defendant has failed to disclose.
